records.title: Full audit and repair of shiftplan 1
records.summary: Read every module in shiftplan and its shipped tests. For each module, treat the docstring as the specification and the code as suspect wherever they disagree. Find every defect: wrong boundary semantics, state leaking between calls, caching that answers an unasked question, arithmetic that loses exactness, and error handling that turns failure into quiet success. Also find the refactor requirements: pluggable ranking strategy with Strategy and GreedyCheapest, assign_shifts signature change, and public API additions. Produce a complete, independent list of defects and the exact code changes to fix them, without consulting any other pass.
